run.name: HILS endurance re-run, build 2026.11.3
run.verdictNote: Gimbal pitch regression reproduced, and a new timing drift on the navigation bus.

anomalies.title: Gimbal pitch step response slower than the twin predicts
anomalies.rootCause: Pitch-axis bearing contamination reproduced from TR-HILS-0057; damping ratio up about 40 percent against baseline.

anomalies.title: Navigation bus timestamps drift against the bench clock
